newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Meilin to list B shares, interim net up.
newsitem.headline: Meilin to list B shares, interim net up.

text.p: Anhui-based refrigerator maker Hefei Meilin Co Ltd, formerly Hefei Meran Co Ltd, said it has been given the green light by the Shenzhen stock exchange to list 100 million class B shares on August 28.

The company also reported in the Shenzhen Securities Times on Monday that it had unaudited net earnings of 79.02 million yuan in the first half of 1996 under Chinese accounting standards, up 32.4 percent from the same period last year.

Earnings per share (EPS) rose to 0.46 yuan from 0.40 yuan, while main operating income climbed to 824.58 million yuan from 669.15 million yuan in the January-June period of 1995, Meilin said. It attributed the rise to stronger refrigerator sales.

Meilin launched an offer of B shares for foreign investors at HK$3.07 per share earlier this month. They carry a projected price/earnings ratio of 5.2 times based on forecast net EPS of 0.64 yuan on a weighted basis for this year.

Meilin now has total share capital of 272.062 million shares. These comprise 100 million B shares, 79.86 million promoter shares, 14.19 million legal person shares, 36,500 staff shares, 18.81 million rights shares transferred from promoter and legal person shareholders, and 59.1655 million A shares.
